source.stem: Decide whether the following statements are correct. Mark “√” for correct answers and “×” for wrong answers. (1) Objects that can move must be living things.

hinge.title: Decide what affects the time period of a simple pendulum at a given place.

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: The time period depends on bob mass, not length.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: A simple pendulum of fixed length has the same time period everywhere.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: All periodically moving objects of the same length have the same time period at a given place.

intelligence.enrichment: At a given place, the time period of a simple pendulum of a given length is constant; it depends on the pendulum's length and not on the bob's mass. Changing the length changes the time period, while changing the bob's mass does not change the time period for pendulums of the same length at the same place. The learner correctly applies this rule: At a given place, the time period of a simple pendulum of a given length is constant; it depends on the pendulum's length and not on the bob's mass. A heavier pendulum bob must have a different time period even when the pendulum length is the same.
